ex.en: She faced a real dilemma: accept the job offer or stay with her family.
ex.zh: 她面临真正的难题：接受这份工作还是留在家人身边。

words.note: 常见搭配是 face a dilemma、in a dilemma，指两难处境。

ex.en: They announced their engagement at a small family dinner.
ex.zh: 他们在一场小型家庭晚餐上宣布订婚。

words.note: engagement 指订婚或约定；engaging 意为迷人的，注意区分。

ex.en: The wealthy businessman donated a large sum to the local school.
ex.zh: 这位富商向当地学校捐了一大笔钱。

words.note: wealthy 比 rich 正式；the wealthy 指富人阶层。

ex.en: The charity works to improve housing in the city's slum areas.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构致力于改善城市贫民区的住房。

words.note: slum 常用复数 the slums 指贫民区，多与住房话题相关。

ex.en: The waves crashed against the rocks and sent white foam into the air.
ex.zh: 海浪拍打岩石，白色泡沫飞溅到空中。

words.note: foam 多指泡沫；foam at the mouth 常比喻大怒。

ex.en: He was criticized for his complete disregard for safety rules.
ex.zh: 他因完全无视安全规定而受到批评。

words.note: disregard 后接名词；名词搭配是 disregard for sth。

ex.en: She earned a degree in business administration before joining the firm.
ex.zh: 她加入公司前获得了工商管理学位。

words.note: administration 可指管理，也可指政府；动词是 administer。

ex.en: Apart from the occasional shower, the weather stayed fine all week.
ex.zh: 除偶尔的阵雨外，整周天气都不错。

words.note: occasional 是形容词，表偶尔；副词 occasionally 更常用。

ex.en: There is no point in dwelling on mistakes you cannot change.
ex.zh: 老想着无法改变的过错没有意义。

words.note: dwell in 现多用于文学；dwell on sth 指反复思虑。

ex.en: The designer incorporated traditional patterns into the new building.
ex.zh: 设计师把传统图案融入了这座新建筑。

words.note: incorporate sth into sth 是固定搭配，含融为一体之意。

ex.en: The proposal sparked a heated debate among the committee members.
ex.zh: 该提案在委员会成员中引发了激烈辩论。

words.note: debate 可作名词和动词；debate on 或 over sth 更常见。

ex.en: Firefighters worked through the night to extinguish the flames.
ex.zh: 消防员连夜扑灭大火。

words.note: extinguish 比 put out 正式；extinguisher 是灭火器。

ex.en: Older people are more vulnerable to the flu in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天老年人更容易患流感。

words.note: be vulnerable to sth 是固定搭配；名词是 vulnerability。

ex.en: They bought most of their furniture at a second-hand market.
ex.zh: 他们的家具大多购自二手市场。

words.note: furniture 不可数，计量用 a piece of furniture。

ex.en: This segment of the market is growing faster than any other.
ex.zh: 这个市场板块比其他任何板块增长都快。

words.note: segment 指整体中划分出的一段；动词意为分割。

ex.en: The minister met her French counterpart to discuss trade.
ex.zh: 部长会见了法国同僚，讨论贸易问题。

words.note: counterpart 指地位或作用相当者，常用于对比两国职位。

ex.en: Parents should practice what they preach if they want children to listen.
ex.zh: 父母要想孩子听话，就该言行一致。

words.note: practice what you preach 是习语，指言行一致。

ex.en: The stage was flanked by two large screens showing the speech.
ex.zh: 舞台两侧各有一块大屏幕播放演讲。

words.note: be flanked by 表两侧有…；flank 也指军事上的侧翼。

ex.en: Hundreds of residents donated blood after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震后数百名居民献血。

words.note: donate sth to sb 或 sth；名词是 donation。

ex.en: Public opinion has swung like a pendulum between the two extremes.
ex.zh: 舆论像钟摆一样在两种极端之间摇摆。

words.note: pendulum 常比喻局势或舆论的摇摆。

ex.en: He left the meeting in defiance of the chairman's orders.
ex.zh: 他违抗主席的命令离开了会场。

words.note: in defiance of 是固定搭配，后接规定、命令等。

ex.en: Every sovereign state has the right to control its own borders.
ex.zh: 每个主权国家都有权控制自己的边界。

words.note: sovereign 指拥有最高权力；名词是 sovereignty。

ex.en: The hotel caters mainly to business travelers and conference groups.
ex.zh: 这家酒店主要接待商务旅客和会议团体。

words.note: cater to 多指迎合需求，cater for 多指提供饮食。

ex.en: The city offers an attractive package of jobs and affordable housing.
ex.zh: 这座城市提供了工作和可负担住房的诱人组合。

words.note: attractive 后接 to 表对某人有吸引力；名词是 attraction。

ex.en: There has been a significant increase in online sales this year.
ex.zh: 今年网上销售额显著增长。

words.note: significant 既可指重要，也可指数量可观，注意语境。

ex.en: Please submit the form in duplicate to the front desk.
ex.zh: 请将表格一式两份交到前台。

words.note: in duplicate 表一式两份；作动词时重音在后。

ex.en: His hand was bleeding heavily, so we rushed him to hospital.
ex.zh: 他的手流血不止，我们赶紧送他去医院。

words.note: bleed 是不规则动词，过去式为 bled；名词是 blood。

ex.en: The government promised to rein in rising house prices.
ex.zh: 政府承诺抑制不断上涨的房价。

words.note: rein in 表约束；give free rein to 表放任，两者相反。

ex.en: The number of accidents decreased by nearly a third last year.
ex.zh: 去年事故数量减少了近三分之一。

words.note: decrease by 表减少幅度，decrease to 表减少到某值。

ex.en: Flags fluttered in the wind along the main street.
ex.zh: 主街道两旁的旗帜在风中飘扬。

words.note: flutter 指轻快地飘动或拍翅，比 fly 更轻。
